exposure: maternal depression in the perinatal period (Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale score >=13 points at 16-24 weeks of gestation and/or 3 months after delivery)
outcome: poor infant sleep at 12 months of age (>3 night wakings, nocturnal wakefulness >1 hr, or total sleep duration <9 hr, assessed by Brief Infant Sleep Questionnaire and 24-hr actigraphy monitoring)
cohort: The study included 2,222 mothers and their infants participating in a population-based birth cohort.
finding: Infants of perinatally depressed mothers showed an adjusted relative risk of 1.44 for >3 night wakings based on questionnaire data, but no association was found with objective actigraphy data.
